_comment: Onboarding questions for /organize. Claude asks them round by round with AskUserQuestion
(max 4 questions per round, 2-4 options each; the user can always type 'Other'),
translated into the user's language. Answers are turned into ~/.organize/config.json by
To extend the onboarding, add a question here. Fields:
when      optional: only ask if earlier answers match, e.g. {"desktop": "sections"}
(a list value means any of them)
set        config values to apply: {"dotted.key": value}; "$user_language" is replaced
by the language code Claude passes as _user_language
values_to  dotted config key of a list that receives the free-text values the user typed
(Claude splits the text into a list and passes it as {"option", "values"})

rounds.intro: First, how do you want each place on your computer to look after a run?

questions.question: How do you want your Desktop?

options.label: Empty
options.description: Everything moves to Documents (or the Trash if it's junk)

options.label: In sections
options.description: Files stay on the Desktop, sorted into a few folders

options.label: Only remove junk
options.description: Leave my files; just clean duplicates, temp files, installers

options.label: Don't touch it
options.description: Never scan or change the Desktop
